AlbumArtIntro: The wand on the Import tab draws a cover for an album with no art. Select the text it shows, top to bottom.
AppleMusicExportHelp: In the Music app, select File > Library > Export Library to pick from every playlist, or export one playlist as XML or text.
ApprovedUsersIntro: These users can queue downloads on the user page. They cannot import into the library.
CacheDirectoryHelp: Leave blank to cache files in the Jellyfin data directory.
ChangeLinkHelp: The upload to download instead. The song keeps its details.
ColorsFromHelp: Draws the colors from these, so the same values always give the same colors.
ConfirmCancelDownloads: Stop the running downloads? Songs that have not finished stay in the queue.
ConfirmDeleteFilesMany: Delete {0} downloaded files? This cannot be undone.
ConfirmDeleteFilesOne: Delete 1 downloaded file? This cannot be undone.
ConfirmDeleteItemsMany: Delete {0} items from the queue? This cannot be undone.
ConfirmDeleteItemsOne: Delete 1 item from the queue? This cannot be undone.
ConfirmResetCache: Delete every cached file and reset the queue? This cannot be undone.
ConfirmResetQueue: Reset the queue? Running downloads stop and the cached files of every item not yet imported are deleted.
ConfirmStopPlaylist: Stop adding songs to this playlist? The Jellyfin playlist and its songs are kept.
DownloadFormatHelp: Opus gives the best quality for its size and MP3 plays everywhere. M4A suits Apple devices.
DownloadIntro: Queues songs to download as audio, ready to tag and import on the Import tab.
EmbedCoverArtHelp: Adds the album cover from Apple's catalog to each downloaded file.
ErrorAddToPlaylists: Could not add songs to the playlists.
ErrorDetailsRequired: Artist, album, and year are required.
ErrorDownloadsRunning: Downloads are in progress. Cancel them on the Download tab, or try again after they finish.
ErrorDownloadsStopping: Downloads are still stopping. Try again in a moment.
ErrorFileTooLarge: The file is too large to be a playlist export.
ErrorFileUnreadable: The uploaded file could not be read.
ErrorImageTooLarge: The image is too large. Use one under 10 MB.
ErrorImageType: Select a JPEG or PNG image.
ErrorImageUnreadable: The image could not be read.
ErrorInternal: Could not complete the request. The server log has the details.
ErrorNoTracks: No tracks were found in the {0} export.
ErrorNotAppleMusicLibrary: The file is not an Apple Music library export.
ErrorNotAppleMusicPlaylist: The file is not an Apple Music playlist export.
ErrorNotSpotifyExport: The file is not a Spotify playlist export.
ErrorNotYouTubeUrl: URL must be a valid YouTube URL.
ErrorOpenPicture: Could not open that file as a picture.
ErrorOwnerNotUser: The selected playlist owner is not a Jellyfin user.
ErrorPictureType: Select a JPEG, PNG, or WebP picture.
ErrorPlayFile: Could not play this file in this browser.
ErrorPlaylistNotInFile: A selected playlist is not in the uploaded file.
ErrorPlaylistTooLarge: This playlist has more than {0} videos, the most you can queue at once. Ask an administrator to add it.
ErrorPluginDirectory: Could not determine the plugin directory.
ErrorQueueUnavailable: The queue could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
ErrorSaveAlbumArt: Could not save the album art.
ErrorSaveApprovedUsers: Could not save the approved users.
ErrorSaveAudioFormat: Could not save the audio format.
ErrorSaveCacheDirectory: Could not save the cache directory.
ErrorSaveImportBehavior: Could not save the import behavior.
ErrorSaveYtDlpPath: Could not save the yt-dlp path.
ErrorServerUnreachable: Could not reach the server. Try again.
ErrorSetCoverMany: Could not set it on {0} files.
ErrorSetCoverOne: Could not set it on 1 file.
ErrorSongDownloading: This song is downloading. Change its link once it finishes.
ErrorSongFileNotFound: That song's file was not found in the library.
ErrorSongFileUnreadable: That song's file could not be read.
ErrorSongInLibrary: This song is already in the library.
ErrorStopPlaylist: Could not stop the playlist import.
ErrorSubmit: The request could not be submitted.
ErrorUnsupportedExport: This file is not a supported playlist export. Use an export from {0}.
ErrorYtDlpPathMissing: The yt-dlp path {0} does not exist.
ErrorZipEmpty: The ZIP holds no playlist exports.
ErrorZipMixed: The ZIP mixes exports from different services.
ErrorZipTooLarge: The ZIP is too large to be a playlist export.
ErrorZipTooManyFiles: The ZIP holds too many files to be a playlist export.
ImportIntro: Tags downloaded songs and imports them into the Jellyfin music library.
InLibraryHelp: The library already has this song. Importing it adds a second copy.
LabelLookUpCatalog: Look up song details on Apple Music
LibraryPathHelp: Files are filed as Path / Artist / Album (Year) / Song.ext. Selecting a library fills in its first folder.
LibrarySongHelp: The song whose audio is wrong. Its file keeps its place in the library, its tags, and its cover.
LookUpCatalogHelp: Fills in the album, album artist, year, track number, and genre from Apple's catalog. Only confident matches are used.
MessageCoverFromAlbum: Cover taken from the library album "{0}".
MessageDenoMissing: Deno could not be set up, so YouTube may refuse some downloads.
MessageEnterAlbumForCover: Enter an album name to generate its cover.
MessageEnterDetails: Add the YouTube link, artist, album and year.
MessageEnterYear: Enter the year as a number, like 2018.
MessageFilePlaylists: This file holds {0} playlists. Turn off any you do not want.
MessageLeftOutDuplicateMany: Left out {0} duplicates or lesser versions.
MessageLeftOutDuplicateOne: Left out 1 duplicate or lesser version.
MessageLeftOutInLibrary: Left out {0} already in the library.
MessageLibraryUpgradeMany: {0} songs replace library singles with the album version.
MessageLibraryUpgradeOne: 1 song replaces a library single with the album version.
MessageLinkChanged: Link changed. Downloading from the new link.
MessageMatchPending: YouTube match is found when downloaded
MessageNoAccess: Your account does not have access to this page.
MessageNoDownloads: No downloaded files yet. Download songs on the Download tab.
MessageNoOtherUsers: No users other than administrators exist yet.
MessageNoSongsQueued: No songs queued yet. Add one above.
MessagePlaylistsTrackedMany: {0} playlists fill in as songs reach the library.
MessagePlaylistsTrackedOne: 1 playlist fills in as songs reach the library.
MessageReplacementQueued: Downloading the replacement for "{0}". Import it on the Import tab.
MessageReplacementQueuedUntitled: Downloading the replacement. Import it on the Import tab.
MessageReplacesSingle: Replaces the single in the library when imported.
MessageSignInToView: Sign in to your account to view this page.
MessageSinglesReplacedMany: {0} library singles were replaced by the album version.
MessageSinglesReplacedOne: 1 library single was replaced by the album version.
PlaylistLimitHelp: The most videos an approved user can queue from one playlist link. 0 is no limit, and administrators are never limited.
PlaylistMatchHelp: Each track is matched to a YouTube upload when it downloads, and keeps the export's details as its tags.
PlaylistOwnerHelp: Each playlist becomes a private Jellyfin playlist of this user, filled as its songs reach the library. A playlist the user already has with that name gets the songs it is missing.
QueueIntro: Songs waiting to be added to the music library, and where each one stands.
ReplaceDuplicatesHelp: Overwrites a file the library already has. When off, the duplicate stays in the download cache.
ReplaceUrlHelp: The video with the right audio. Importing it on the Import tab overwrites the song's file.
RequestDownloadIntro: Paste a YouTube link to a song or a playlist. Audio-only or lyric uploads work best.
ResetCacheHelp: Deletes every file in the download cache and clears the download queue.
ResetIntro: Both stop running downloads first and cannot be undone.
ResetQueueHelp: Clears the download queue and deletes the cached files of every item not yet imported.
SettingsIntro: Sets where songs go and how they are downloaded. Each section saves on its own.
SourceAppleMusicHelp: Upload a playlist or library exported from the Music app.
SourceReplaceHelp: Swap a library song's audio for a different YouTube upload.
SourceYouTubeHelp: Paste a link to a video or a playlist.
SpotifyExportHelp: Export one playlist as a CSV file, or all of them as a ZIP, with {0}. Liked Songs downloads its songs without becoming a playlist.
TargetLibraryHelp: The Jellyfin music library imported files are placed in.
UpdateYtDlpHelp: Update yt-dlp updates yt-dlp and Deno without waiting for the next check. It waits for running downloads, so cancel them on the Download tab to update now.
YouTubeUrlHelp: A video or playlist link. Each video is queued to download as audio.
YtDlpIntro: The plugin downloads {0} and the {1} runtime it needs, checks each against its published checksum, and updates them every 12 hours.
YtDlpPathHelp: The absolute path of your own yt-dlp. Leave blank to use the plugin's copy.
